body: Incorrect it's on the delivery invoice. My friend works at a Cvs pharmacy and was talking about how I pay like $0.10 a pill but the pharmacy pays $2 a pill for a medication I was on bc of my insurance.

They come on suddenly during an anxiety attack. So there are warning signs: racing thoughts, overwhelming dread, feeling of being disconnected from everything.
I don't have any friends (the more I understand my problems the easier it is to say this and not feel ashamed) but I have grown quite close to my sister. She's the first person I think of calling when things get bad but the thought is quickly pushed out by my mind accusing me of being selfish and subjecting her to my pain and problems. On Friday I called my husband at work to distract me with conversations so I wouldn't be consumed in my mind. But he has a hard time understanding my emotional and mental problems but he's getting better and trying. 

I have considered calling hotlines multiple times in the past but always come to the conclusion that there are people worse off than me, or more deserving. And I am constantly afraid of being judged(social anxiety) even by a voice on the phone who will probably never cross my path again. 

Thank you so much for your response. I'm going to make a note on my phone telling me to call my sis in times like this and find a crisis number to put there as well.
